title: POS orders
description: Orders completed at the Point of Sale till.

help.title: About POS orders
help.overview: A POS order is a sale rung up on a till. This page is the record of those sales. Rows are not created, edited, or deleted here.

sections.title: What a row is
sections.body: The sale is written when the till takes payment. The list is how you find it afterwards.
items: States are draft, paid, cancelled, and refunded.
The row keeps the session, the till, the cashier, and the customer when one was attached.
Reprint, from the row menu, sends the receipt again.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: A refund is not an edit of the original sale. It is another order.
items: A paid sale is refunded from the till, in full or by line quantity.
The refund order stays linked to the sale it reverses.
Each sale line remembers how much of it has already been refunded, so a second refund cannot cover the same units twice.

sections.title: Where to do the work
sections.body: Money moves on the till. This page is for looking the sale up.
items: Open Point of Sale to sell, hold a cart, or refund.
Open POS sessions to see the drawer that sale belonged to.
Catalog product orders are a different list. A till sale does not appear there.
